column1: # Modules of the server dumps of the Linux-Hardware.org DMI collection (github.com/linuxhw/DMI, commit 57b21bc, CC BY 4.0),
# for the coverage of the population check: per populated memory device the dump, its locator and bank locator, which
# device of that name it is (from 1), and what the ledger reads of the module: size in MiB, module type (RDIMM, LRDIMM,
# UDIMM or empty), ranks and rated speed in MT/s (0 when not given), and the part number as a class of its dump (P1, P2,
# ...: equal part numbers get one class; no part number of a dump is kept). Written from the dumps by lane E of BP.
